title: Doubly Robust Alignment for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.01183v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper studies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning large language models with human preferences. While RLHF has demonstrated promising results, many algorithms are highly sensitive to misspecifications in the underlying preference model (e.g., the Bradley-Terry model), the reference policy, or the reward function, resulting in undesirable fine-tuning. To address model misspecification, we propose a doubly robust preference optimization algorithm that remains consistent when either the preference model or the reference policy is correctly specified (without requiring both). Our proposal demonstrates superior and more robust performance than state-of-the-art algorithms, both in theory and in practice. The code is available at https://github.com/DRPO4LLM/DRPO4LLM

translated_title: 大语言模型的双重重稳健对齐
translated_abstract: 本文研究了基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），用于将大语言模型与人类偏好进行对齐。尽管RLHF已经展现出令人瞩目的成果，但许多算法对底层偏好模型（如Bradley-Terry模型）、参考策略或奖励函数的设定错误高度敏感，从而导致不理想的微调效果。为了解决模型设定错误的问题，我们提出了一种双重稳健的偏好优化算法，该算法在偏好模型或参考策略中任意一个被正确设定的情况下（无需两者同时正确）仍能保持一致性。我们的方法在理论和实践中都展现出比最先进算法更优越、更稳健的性能。代码已发布于 https://github.com/DRPO4LLM/DRPO4LLM
tldr: 提出了一种双重稳健的偏好优化算法（DRPO），只要偏好模型或参考策略中有一个被正确设定，即可实现一致的大语言模型对齐，有效解决了RLHF中的模型设定错误问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a doubly robust preference optimization algorithm that remains consistent for LLM alignment as long as either the preference model or the reference policy is correctly specified, effectively addressing model misspecification in RLHF.
